Handrick Brill Momin This Beok belonys te Gov --- Page 5 --- Janapchengani A.B.M.D.K. ni skanggipa seminarko seminarni bi- mango ong'srangjaoba Krima II ni Rajasimla mondolio 1993 bilsio ong'atchenga chol ong'aha. Una skang bil- siantin puja chutimitingo conferenceko ong atrongaha.

Gnigipa seminarko 1994 o Krima III ni Rongara songo seminarni bimangon chu'sokatna man ahani gimin chinga Isolko mittela. Seminaro bakko ra pagipa delegaterang sakantian Isolni gital patianirangko man'aha. Uamang an'tangtangsan patianiko man'e dongna sikaijaha indiba gipinrangbi maikai apsan dake man'pagen induke je subjectraagni gimin uno skie on'aha uarangko chongipa kitapni bimango ong'katatchina A.B.M.D.K ko didiaha.
A.B.M.D.K. gita iako re'anggipa Dadenggte D.K. sobhao Me'chik delegaterangni chanchianiona ra'angon pilakan uko chongipa kitapni bimango chapa ka'atna namnike ra'chaktokaha.
Iako chapa ka'atani A.B.M.- D.K. ni lapna ong'ja indiba poraie nigipa sakantini gisikna maiba narugipa chanchianiko &io ma'siataniko A. gita naatpana ine miksonganiosa ong a.

Seminarna segiminoniko bang'gijakosan banoba banoba namdapataniko dake chapa ka'ataha. Pilak skigiparangan an'tangtangni jakchakgijagipa somoirangko done ching- ko dakchakahanina A.B.M.D.K ni pal anga uamang sakantikon mittela. Isol pilakaan patidhina.
Sept. Sellitha N. Sangma A.B M.D.K.,Secretary A.

Mission Compound, Tura. --- Page 6 --- CIVIC SENSE AGANCHENGANI Pilakna skangba an'ching " Civic sense " inon maiko miksonga nichengna. Civic kattara gipin kattako talatgipa ba adjective ong'a aro songjinmani bidingo ba a'songo songdongkamgipa/songpanggipani ( citizen) bidingo talatna jakkalgipa katta ong'a.

Sense inon ning'- oni chanchiani, gisikni bewal ba ong'anina, kraanina chanchianiko miksonga. Civic sense inon an'ching bang'batd changon rongial an'talani aro sel'taani bidingo mangsongbat- ronga. lndiba ian kosakgilgil agananisan ong'aia.

Civic sense inahdon songsarnl, juthl, a'songui aro mandeni salantini janggi tanganio mdndeskaming bakrimani dak- rim-ka'rimani pilak hidingrangkon man'chapa. Mandeni gisikni bewalrang, daka-ka'ani bewal- rang, gunrang, gisik seng e aro wa'sae songsarni re'anio bak ra'paani, songui-nokni janggi tanganio chu'soke jak onpaani, ia pilakan civic sense-o nangchapea. Songsar- ko naubatatani, songni-nokni kamrangko ma'siani, song- ni-nokni ba a'songni kamrango bak Ia'pana nanggipa changa-sapanirangko skie-ma'sie ra'ani aro mande aro samtangtangni nangringrikaniko ma'slani, iarangoba civic sense-ni katta nakata.

Mandeara saksan.tangaigija, tom'dake ba doi dake janggi tanggipa ong'a. Indaken saksani chanchiaai aro daka ka'ani bewal jinmanni janggi tanganio nangchakea. Apsan dake jinmani chanchiani aro daka-ka'ani bewal- ba saksani kosako bilmanskaa.

Indake saksara jinmana aro jinmara saksana chanchina aro kam ka na ga'aka. Naljokaninaba, jakgitelaninaba mande mandeskaku nanga --- Page 7 --- aro niam done, dol dake janggi tangrimnaba draatako man'a. Mande saksani be'eno gisiko an seng aro kusi ong'e janggi tanganiara bakrimanio, dakna nanggnirango bal chilrimanio, saksa sakgipinni chanchianirangko mande ra'anio aro chakchikgrikanio pangchaka.
Songpanggipara Sawa. State ba a'songo donggipa, a'songni on'gimin bilrang donggipa aro a'songna dakna nanggnirangko chu'sokat. gipu mandean songpanggipa (citizen) ong'a.

Songpang- gipa an'tangna on'gimin bilrangkosan rakkiaigija, sak- gipin!angni bilrangkoba mande ra'a. Uni chanchiani, be- wai al' kam sakgipino nangchakea ine ua ma'sia. Sak- gipinko gisik saatjana, be'eno saknaatjana aro kragija bewalchi ba kamchi duk ong'atjana gita ua simsaka.

A- songni an'tangna on'gimin bilko ua krae jakkala aro man'na nanggnirangko dabina ua kenja. Gipin dake agan- ode, uo chu'gimik civic sense donga. Iani bidiogo dingtang dingtang bidingrangko nie nina.
Salantiri Janggi Tangani Bidingo. Chu'gimik jakgitelaniko man'na darangba ka'dongna manju. Torom olakkina, an'tangni ska gita janggi tangna aro chanchiatangko parakna jakgitelani dongna nanga.

Indiba saksani jakgitelaniara sakgipinrangni jakgitelani- chi tong'kandiatako man'a. Saksani jakgitelani bon ku- jaon, sakgipinni jakgitelani a'bachengskaa. Rama soroko skatang jebasi gari chalaina jakgitelaniko onja, maina indake dakode, sakgipinni janggina kenchakani donga.

Soroko rama re'na aro garirangko chalaina dongimin niamrang donga. Ia niamrangko gimikni naljokanina dona. Skatang gari chalaiode ba sorokni niamrangko manijao- de, ua mande civic senseni bidingo uisrangkuja.

Uni simsakgijanichi sakgipin mande saknaa ba janggi gimaata. --- Page 8 --- Civic sense donggipaniko rama sorokrangko dingtang bimangoba nika. Ramao maiba a'sel ong'ode, pilakan chagrime nia, indiba ja'a jak be'gipako, an'chi pakenggi- pako hospitalchi ra'na inode kattokaia.

Ian sakgipinna chanchiani gisik donggijani a'sel ong'a. Dokano bostu ra'na, cinema nina ba bus gario gadona manderangni jilpretpretako nikronga. Jilpretachi solmal ong'a, saobade saknae ra'a aro bakbakani pal jarobatata.
Riting dakchengjani gimin skang re'bagipa. rangsa ja'manchakpila. Riting dake sengode jikjakani komia, darangnaba be'en aro gisik saani ong'ja aro kam ta-rakbata.

Civic sense donggipa mandede ia bewalkosa ja'rika. Ramasamo pipeni chi joke dongengako nikronga Chi chakmano ba jakkalmano pipe-ko tekna simsakgija- ni ba pipe ku'sik nosto ong'ak o tarina gisik nanggijani a'sel indake ong'a. Chi jokbrakode rama re'toja; iano chi jokgalenga, gipinode chi ringnan man'jaenga.

Indonga chanchianirang dongjaode, civic sense dongkuja. Minggipin kragifa kamara jeo jao jabol galaiani. Mitamrang noktang-jamtangko chijenge rakkia, indiba jabol etrokgalgiminkode  jawani baganchisa galataijok ba soroko pakbrok donaijok.

Jillarangode chi moelako ba jabolko kosakoni kelki gita pakataia. An'tangnasan Chauchiaigipa mande iarangko gisik neng'mangijan daka. Cha'a ringani bewalba mandeni chanchininganiko ba chanchininggijaniko mesokpila, An'chingni a'song mitam cha'anirrngko gipin a'sougrangoniko ra'baa aro indake cha'anirangni dam raka.

A'songo ge'a gamaniba mikka bilsi tik ongjaode silja; unode cha'ani komia aro mitamde okgimue chakna ga'aka. Indimangba an'- ching salantian indita cha'aniko nosto ka a. --- Page 9 --- An'chingni salantini ramram bewalrangko niate nina.

Sakgipinni songbad ba ehitti poraio janggilchini ra'bae poraigitikpacaniko mitamde maming gitan nikja Indiba gnigipa mande skanggipa mandeni jakgitelani bil- ko ong siatenga. Sakgipioni chittiko skatang kulie porai- anib: ia apsan obostaon ga'aka. Sakgipinni aganmitingo sengnapgija  agandapdapaniara aganenggipako mande ra'gijani chin ong'a.

SOMOENA SIMSAKANI Somoena rikani gisik an'chingo komibea. Somoe gamchatbea aro gimaatgimin somoeko maming saloba man'pilja. Tom'aniona mande saksa sokchenge, gipin- rangde kontasa ja'manchakode, skapggipa mandede kam a'sel bon'aijok.
Sak 20 ja'manchakbaode kanta 21 ( 1+20 ) kode gimaatjok. Somoena rikjaode nokdang- ni kamoba ong'china mondolini kamoba ong'china. gisik sagrikanirang nakatnaba donga.

Somoena ka'sa- gijagipa mandeo civic sense komia, maina ua sakgipin- ni somoenaba ka'saja. An tangni aro gipinni somoeko indin bon atjana simsakbena nanga. An'seng-baljokani, aro Rongtal-an'talani Bidingo An'seng-baljokani aro rongtal-an'talani niamrangko saoba maaijaode an'ching, "Civic sense-an dongja".

ine aganronga. Mingsa an'chingni namatna napggipa bewal- ara sturamramani. Stuming re'chapgipa saatgipa jo'ong rang balwa gita chi gita sakgipinona sokangskae, uks sadta, Su buramramatiba kragijagipa bewal mingsa.
Ia bewal oitogijanisan ong'aije, sua ding'aniko giproroata ni cholba ong'a. Mitam ma'a paarang dedrangko ram3. sams a'pal re'ata bs a'pal re'aniko jebasi gala.

An'- chingoi indakgipa simsakgijaaichi ba chanchiningsjani chi sakgipinrang sia-suaniko man a. --- Page 10 --- 6- Dingtang somoeo dingtang biapo, Moseni ge'et- gimin Isolna dakna nanggoiara sakantini janggi tanganio nangea. Deuteronomy 13:12-13,o dakgrikani a'tipni 8'palo s'pal re'na biap donna agana.

A'pal re'na skang a'kol cho's, a'pal re'manahaon, silchidareming re'bitchap- gipa golchongchi a'pal re'atangko a'adappilna agana. Aitip Isolna rongtalna nanga. Ia Moseni ge'etanio Jiho- vana vitoani, mandeni an'seng-baljokani aro sakgipinna chanchianiko man'gopa.

An'chingni gipin kragija bewalara, rumalkode ra'- bita, indiba gingkode a'aosa etgala aro sakgipino gusu- dapa / atchingdapa. Ian sabisiko sakgipinna sualatani gimin gelna nanggipa bewal ong'a. Gam'ani Bidingo Ku'aganani, Radio Television watani, gari horn jakkalani, loudspeakero git gam'atani, ia pilakan duga- pile gam'ode saksa sakgipinna dongtogijaniko ba sakna- aniko ra'baa.

Gam'dugaaniko ruuta somoena nachil chak- na nangode, mandeni knaani bil komiroroange, ja'mano nagok ong'a. Tom'bimongao ba biao salang walang loudskeaker jakkalaniara, songni nokni manderangna dongtogijani ong'pila aro tuna dongna man'japilata. Radio ba Television gam e watra skang, noktan- go ba noksulo saoba porikkana p iraiengama, saoba saengama, saniba noko duk kalimdni ong'engama chan- chichengna nanga.

Hospital sepangrangn ka'ding-an'senge roani aro born iakkaldugaaniko chempengani donga, maina jaranga Chrik-a'boke roani, gam'e golpo ka ani aro uagita bewalranga mandeskana nama ongja. Somoe bidp aro obostako nie ka'ding-an'senganiko dakjaode, sakgipinna chanchiani gisik chinapkuja. Nikrongbatgij a obostade

Tom'bimongao ba biao salang walang loudskeaker jakkalaniara, songni nokni manderangna dongtogijani ong'pila aro tuna dongna man'japilata. Radio ba Television gam e watra skang, noktan- go ba noksulo saoba porikkana p iraiengama, saoba saengama, saniba noko duk kalimdni ong'engama chan- chichengna nanga.

Hospital sepangrangn ka'ding-an'senge roani aro born iakkaldugaaniko chempengani donga, maina jaranga Chrik-a'boke roani, gam'e golpo ka ani aro uagita bewalranga mandeskana nama ongja.
